title: Structural Audit - Login Page Accessibility
description: Verify login page loads correctly and displays all required UI elements. DO NOT attempt to create accounts or complete OAuth flow. Expected: Page loads, elements visible, NO 401 errors on login page itself.

steps.description: Navigate to /login page (port 3001)
Verify page loads without errors (status 200, no 401 errors)
Verify login form title '¡Bienvenido!' is visible
Verify 'Iniciar Sesión con Google' button is present and visible
Verify NO 401 errors appear in console for the login page itself
Verify page structure matches expected layout

title: Structural Audit - Route Navigation and Redirects
description: Verify all routes redirect correctly for unauthenticated users. Expected: Protected routes redirect to /login, public routes load. 401 errors are EXPECTED for API calls from protected pages.

steps.description: Navigate to /dashboard (should redirect to /login)
Verify redirect to /login occurs (401 errors in console are expected during redirect)
Navigate to /patients (should redirect to /login)
Verify redirect to /login occurs
Navigate to /reports/new (should redirect to /login)
Verify redirect to /login occurs
Navigate to /faqs (should be accessible or redirect)
Verify page loads or redirects correctly

title: Structural Audit - File Structure Verification
description: Verify all expected page files exist and routes are accessible (may redirect)

steps.description: Check that /login route exists and loads (200 status)
Check that /dashboard route exists (may redirect, 401 errors expected)
Check that /patients route exists (may redirect, 401 errors expected)
Check that /reports/new route exists (may redirect, 401 errors expected)
Check that /session-workspace route exists (may redirect, 401 errors expected)
Check that /account route exists (may redirect, 401 errors expected)
Check that /faqs route exists
Check that /onboarding route exists (may redirect, 401 errors expected)

title: Audio Recording Interface Verification
description: Verify VoiceRecorder component structure is present (without executing recording). Note: 401 errors are EXPECTED when accessing protected routes.

steps.description: Navigate to /session-workspace?patientId=test (will redirect to login, 401 errors expected)
Verify redirect occurs correctly (401 errors in console are normal)
Verify page structure loads (even if redirected)

title: Report Generation Interface Verification
description: Verify report generation UI structure (without generating reports). Note: 401 errors are EXPECTED when accessing protected routes.

steps.description: Navigate to /reports/new (will redirect to login, 401 errors expected)
Verify redirect occurs correctly (401 errors in console are normal)
Verify page structure loads (even if redirected)

title: Navigation Components Structure
description: Verify navigation components render correctly on public pages

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Verify page loads with proper structure (no 401 errors on login page)
Verify page has proper HTML structure

title: API Routes Accessibility
description: Verify API routes exist. Note: 401 errors are EXPECTED for protected API routes without authentication.

steps.description: Check /api/auth/login route exists
Verify route responds (401 is expected without auth, but route exists)
Check /api/auth/session route exists
Verify route responds (401 is expected without auth, but route exists)
Check /api/get-patient-appointments route exists
Verify route responds (401 is expected without auth, but route exists)

title: Middleware Redirect Functionality
description: Verify middleware correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login. 401 errors are EXPECTED during redirect process.

steps.description: Navigate to root path /
Verify redirect to /login or /dashboard occurs (401 errors during redirect are normal)
Navigate to protected route /dashboard
Verify redirect to /login occurs (401 errors are expected)
Navigate to protected route /patients
Verify redirect to /login occurs (401 errors are expected)

title: Page Layout and Structure
description: Verify page layouts render correctly with proper HTML structure on public pages

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Verify page has proper HTML structure (html, body, main elements)
Verify page has proper meta tags and title
Verify page loads without console errors (except expected 401s from protected API calls)

title: Error Handling Verification
description: Verify that 401 errors are handled gracefully and pages still render correctly

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Verify page renders correctly despite any 401 errors from background API calls
Verify user can see login form even if some API calls fail with 401
